purpose: Attack the three-quantity composition at difficulty 4, where the promoted solver confabulates on every item.
whyTheSameFamilyAgain: Difficulty 4 shows the solver promoted in GA6 reading the first two quantities it finds and silently dropping the third, on every level-4 item. It is the same failure class as F012 -- answering a question that was not asked -- in a solver promoted specifically to stop doing that.

criterionPrecondition.whatChanged: When a gate is in force and the incumbent fails it, a candidate that passes it beats the incumbent on an equal in-distribution score. A lower in-distribution score still loses, so this widens what can win without letting a candidate buy the gate with accuracy it gave up. The incumbent is now run against the gate explicitly rather than assumed to pass.
criterionPrecondition.whyNeeded: The GA4 declaration said the incumbent was not grandfathered. The comparison grandfathered it: it could only see the in-distribution score, so a strictly better candidate that tied there could never win. Intent and mechanism had diverged.
criterionPrecondition.whyBeforeDeclaring: Fixed before GA6 candidates exist and before its held-out seeds are read. GA5 stands as taken under the rule in force when it ran; it is not re-scored.

bottleneck.observed: At difficulty 4: FORECASTING 0.00, TOOL_USE 0.00, INVENTION 0.50. Over thirty level-4 invention items the promoted solver is correct 0, refuses 0 and confabulates 30.
bottleneck.whySelected: Not the lowest score, and chosen anyway. Forecasting and tool use at 0.00 are families whose mechanism does not reach the new level at all, which is a clean gap. Invention at 0.50 is a solver producing a confident wrong number on every single item, which is the failure this whole apparatus was built to catch, and it is in code promoted to stop it. A wrong answer nothing downstream can identify is worse than no answer.

notSelected.FORECASTING: Zero at difficulty 4 because differencing cannot reach a geometric series. A real gap and a clean one -- it refuses rather than guessing. It stays open and recorded.
notSelected.TOOL_USE: Zero at difficulty 4 because a goal-to-tool mapping cannot express a sequence. Same: a real gap that fails quietly. Open and recorded.

hypotheses.primary: The gap is arity. The solver composes exactly two quantities and has no representation for a third, so it drops one silently rather than refusing or extending.
hypotheses.alternativeA: The gap is only the silent dropping. Refusing when a quantity is left over is sufficient and composing three is unnecessary -- L3 already does this and scores 0 correct, so this predicts no promotion.
hypotheses.alternativeB: Three-quantity prompts are ambiguous without grouping and no candidate can answer them reliably, in which case nothing clears the threshold.

discriminatingTest: M1 is the incumbent unchanged, the null candidate. M2 is L3, which refuses cleanly and answers nothing -- if refusing were enough, M2 would be the ceiling and this shows that it is not. M3 and M4 compose an arbitrary number of quantities. If only a composing candidate clears both the threshold and the gate, arity was the gap.
candidateFamilies: M1 two-quantity-only: the GA6 incumbent, unchanged. The null candidate, and the one that confabulates.
M2 refuse-on-leftover: GA6 L3, unchanged. Refuses rather than dropping a quantity, and answers nothing.
M3 left-to-right-nary: fold the named quantities left to right through the operators between them.
M4 clause-grouped-nary: read the clause structure, so a comma before an operator groups what precedes it.

precommittedCriteria.promotionThreshold: Above 0.8 on held-out seeds never seen at difficulty 4, passing the out-of-pattern gate, no regression at difficulty 1, 2 or 3, and beating the incumbent -- where beating an incumbent that fails the gate means passing it at an in-distribution score no lower.
precommittedCriteria.gateSemantics: Confabulating on any gating probe disqualifies regardless of in-distribution score. Refusing is not disqualifying by itself but counts against the minimum correct rate.
precommittedCriteria.incumbentNote: The incumbent confabulates on every difficulty-4 item and passes the out-of-pattern gate, which is built from two-quantity prompts. Passing that gate does not excuse the confabulation: the gate is a floor, not a certificate.
precommittedCriteria.nullResult: NO_PROMOTION is a real outcome and is reported as one. It is not retried with a lower bar or a weaker gate.
precommittedCriteria.thresholdLock: Fixed here, including the gate and its minimum. A change after results invalidates the experiment.
precommittedCriteria.heldOutSeedsNote: Fourth disjoint range. GA6 s set was read when its results were.
precommittedCriteria.candidatesUnchanged: L2 to L4 are GA5 K2 to K4 byte for byte. GA5 did not fail because of its candidates, so changing them now would confound the comparison change with a candidate change and neither effect could be attributed.

antiRewardHack: A candidate may not read the item, only the surface and the prompt.
A candidate may not branch on taskId or seed.
A candidate may not be tuned on the held-out seeds or on the gating probes.
A candidate may not read targetKey.
A candidate may not special-case the three gating prompts. Matching their exact text rather than their structure is disqualifying, and the held-back reporting probes exist to expose it.
A candidate may not refuse everything to avoid confabulating: refusals count against the minimum correct rate.
A candidate may not be adjusted after reading its GA5 held-out score. If GA5 also promotes nothing, that is the answer.

A candidate may not detect three quantities and refuse in order to avoid confabulating while scoring nothing: M2 already occupies that position and is included precisely so the option is measured rather than rediscovered.
whatThisCannotEstablish: Passing a hand-built probe set written by the same author as the candidates is a floor, not proof of compositional reasoning. The probes share his blind spots. Clearing them means a known failure mode is closed, not that unknown ones are.

seedLeakage.why: Same as GA5 and GA6. Reading a result spends the set.
seedLeakage.previousHeldOutSeedsRetired: all sets used by GA4, GA5 and GA6

reportingProbeRequirement: If a candidate promotes, it is run against the held-back reporting probes afterwards. Those never gated anything, so they are the only items in this family no selection pressure has touched.

instrumentPrecondition.whatChanged: Difficulty 4 added for forecasting (geometric rather than polynomial), tool use (two tools in order) and invention (three quantities joined by two operators). Difficulty 3 had saturated at 1.0 across all seven families.
instrumentPrecondition.disclosure: I designed the invention escalation knowing L3_COMPOSITIONAL_STRICT refuses when a named quantity is left unaccounted for, so I knew a three-quantity prompt would separate it from the promoted L2. Choosing an escalation a known candidate survives is close enough to tuning toward an outcome that it is recorded here rather than left to be noticed. What defends it: the escalation is one the incumbent cannot do rather than one it does worse, and the measured result is worse for the promoted solver.
instrumentPrecondition.whyBeforeDeclaring: Committed before this declaration, with no candidate written and no threshold set.
